tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs rin po che'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyi ye shes ni// smon lam sgyu ma'i byad pos mtshan bzang dang*// dpe byad 'od du 'bar bar sprul pa'i gzugs// dran pas rmongs pa'i sgrib sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs// de dang tha dad min par gyur pa'i zhal// srid gsum 'gro la dgyes pa'i 'dzum sgros nas// rnam par spros pa'i chos kyi bkraṃ shisaṃ dbyangs// 'gag med lhunaṃ grubaṃ smra ba'i dbang pos srungs/ 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gser gyi mngal can gyi// thod las bab pa'i sgrub thabs mtho ris klung*// bstan 'dzin skal ldan shing rtas spel ba'i rgyun/ don gnyer lha bu'i sgrib pa sbyang phyir spro// de la 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i sgrub thabs nyid ni/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas grub kyi slob dpon chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa/ da lta sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtshor grags pa'i rgya bod kyi bstan bcos chen po rnams nas 'byung ba/ de'i spyi 'gro mi shes pa'i las dang po pa dag gi don du cung zad spel ba'i sgo nas nyams su blang bde ba zur du bkol ba la gnyis te rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa'o// dang po la'ang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis las/ dang po ni dus gang yang rung bar sgrub pa po kha la sogs pa dag par byas te/ bsam gtan gyi khang par stan bde ba la bsdad de/ spro na 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags tshar gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ rgya gzhung rnams dang sa chen gyis sgrub thabs 'grel pa rnams su de ltar bshad do// de nas skyabs yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par dmigs la/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa ci nus dang*/ mthar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams kyi byin rlabs rang gzhan gyi rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes pa lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i muṃ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa lan gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ ngag tu/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod de rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa la/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa bstim pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyud bklag pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

rwa ba gur/ rdo rje de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi rwa bas phyi rol nas yongs su bskor ba/ de'i nang du hṝḥlas pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du muṃ yig dkar dmar/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mkhyen pa dang brtse ba dang*/ spobs pa dang gzungs la sogs pa'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs te muṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa/ sku dang rtsa zhal dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ g.yas zhal sngo zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ shin tu gzhon zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus sprad pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar sems ma rdo rje ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje snying gar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dpral bar rin chen rdo rje ma ser mo spyi bor me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ mgrin par pad+ma rdo rje ma dmar ser g.yon pad+ma 'dzin cing g.yas pas de'i kha 'byed pa/ spyi bor las kyi rdo rje ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'tshir ba'i tshul gyis spyi bor 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i rjes su yang 'og gi sngags tshar gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i muṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

gong bzhin mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'am spro na/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha hoḥzhes pas bstim/ de'i dus su rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bca' bar gsungs te/ de yang lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bcings te/ sdigs mdzub dang mthe'u chung lcags sgrog tu byas shing sprad pa bkan te rang gi kha ru nye bar bzhag pa'o// gsum pa ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ de la oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas oṃ sarba dharmā bha wa swa bhā wa/ bi shud+dha badz+ra tsak+ṣu a ā aṃ aḥ pra kṛ te pa ri shud+dha sarba dharmā ya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya/ mañdzu shrī pa ri shud+dhi ta mu pa dā ya ti/ a sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ ha ra ha ra oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbha ga wān dz+nyā na murti/ wā gī shwa ra ma hā wa tsa/ sarba dharmā ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shud+dha dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ zhes pa'i sngags tshar gcig brjod pas 'dir yang byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du muṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim par bsams la/

oṃ sarba dharmā bha wa sogs sngags kyi bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// bzhi pa ni de dag sngon du song bas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa nyi ma re re zhing lan gcig gam gsum la sogs par skyil mo krung ma bshig par mnyam par bzhag pas bklag par bya ste/ de yang rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i muṃ yig gam a yig las tshig thams cad skyes shing mi dmigs par bsams la gdon par bya'o/ 'dir snga ma ni lha 'di nyid kyi sa bon yin pas mi 'gal bar sems shing phyi ma ni sa paṇa gyis/ 'jam dpal gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'don pa dang lha gzhan gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'don pa gnyis ka la a yig bsgom par gsungs te/ de yang rgyud las/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /ces sogs kyi don du dgongs pa'i man ngag go / thun bsdu ba na bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas sogs kyis dge ba bsngo ba dang smon lam gang shes btab ste rtag tu lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// thun mtshams sogs su gtor ma 'bul ba spro na/ dge ba bsngo ba'i gong der dkar gtor chu gtsang gis bran te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor mgron rgyas pa ni/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar hrīḥlas pad+ma sogs nas bdag nyid ces pa dor ba ma gtogs gong ltar bskyed cing ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/

yi ge bzhis bstim/ slar yang sogs kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la sogs nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab sngar bzhin bya/ bsdu na skad cig gis spyan drang ba gang mos bya/ de nas gtor ma nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro bas mchod de gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ bskyed chog rgyas pa ltar na dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs gong ltar bya'o// de lta bu'i ngang nas ji srid du grub pa'i mtshan ma ma byung ba de srid du 'bad par bya ste/ de yang lha dngos su byon nas khyod kyis dngos grub sgrubs shig dang gang 'dod pa 'grub bo zhes bya ba la sogs pa rmi lam sogs su 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de byung ba na rgyud nas ji skad bshad pa'i dngos grub gang bsgrubs kyang 'grub bo// yang na mtshan ma ni smig rgyu dang*/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga mthong nas ring por mi thogs par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang thob pa la sogs pa ste/ rgyas pa ni rgyud kyi phan yon gyi steng du rtogs par bya'o// smras pa/ thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong mchog tu// 'jug la bar du gcod pa'i sgrib pa dag /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu'i ting 'dzin gyis// drung nas 'byin pa'i thabs la 'di rmad byung*// de mthong tshe na sngon byung ra mā ṇas/ mda' dang gnam ru phal pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// laṅka'i dbang phyug gnad la phug pa'i gtam// brtse dang byang sems med phyir 'di bas dman// 'jam dpal go 'phang bla med khang bzangs rtser// mngon par 'dzegs la dka' ba med pa'i 'phrul// mtshan nas yang dag brjod pa'i 'jam dpal gyi// sgrub thabs rin po che yi them skas gang*// rnam gzhag spyi yi khong nas khyad par chos// 'phags bod mkhas pa'i gzhung don ma 'phyugs gtam// smras 'di snying la mi 'bab med gyur na// sgo gsum dge bar sbyor ba'i gsos su long*// tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i bsod nams g.yab mo yis// byang chub bar gyi skye nas skye ba'i phreng*// 'jam dpal dge ba'i bshes su khugs dang mnyam// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa rgyas byed shog

/de ltar mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs rin po che'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lam 'di la mos pa'i gang zag las dang po pa a yig skye ba med pa ngag tu 'don par bya ba'i ming can la phan pa'i ched du/ rje ngor chen chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me la gzhi byas/ der mi gsal ba'i khyad par rnams sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho'i rgya gzhung dang*/ rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i yig sna dang bsdus don/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs spyi'i rnam gzhag sogs bod gzhung tshad ldan rnams dang mi 'gal bar cung zad spros te/ thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung gi bdud rtsis skal ba sbom por gyur pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas lcags sprel gyi lo'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags dang*/ ye shes pa dang dbang lha'i mchod pa gnyis/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya rnams dor ba tsam gyis sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i thun mong ba'i 'gros kyang ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par nus so// maṅga laṃ// // ༄// 'jam dpal ye shes bzang po'i bstod sgrub nyams su len tshul zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yab gyur kyang*// srid gsum rmongs pa gcod pa'i dgra// blo gros mchog ster 'jam pa'i dbyangs// bstod pas grub byed sgrub thabs brtsam// thog mar sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis/ 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po rnams// rig pas brtags na 'ga' ma rnyed// ma rnyed pa de don dam yin// gdod nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do// zhes pa ltar chos thams cad bdag med pa'i don dran par bya/

de'i ngang las rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐/ dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥyig dmar ser/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ spro na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la 'khod pa ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog gur gum gyi mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po tis mtshan pa'i ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang zur phud lnga 'phyang ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gsal btab/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal bas// ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin// gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thom sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// 'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung*// 'brug ltar cher sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog sgrol mdzad cing*// ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams// gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku// bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spros bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// ces pa'i bstod pa de nyid kyis lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/ bcu gcig gam/ nyer gcig la sogs pas bstod pa'i mthar/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dhīḥyig sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer byung ste rang la thim pas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dngos grub gnang bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes pa ci nus shig bzlas mthar/ thal mo sbyar te/ brtse ldan khyed kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bskyed du gsol// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar// bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs mgon gyis ni// bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed kyi lha oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol la/ 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa// de yis skye bo thams cad kyis// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /ces sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod do// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bstod pa brgya stong la sogs pa ji ltar nus pa nyams su blangs pas gzhung gis bstan pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba ni nges pa'o// bya ba'i rgyud ltar lhag pa'i lha/ rje 'bangs tshul gyis sgrub pa'i thabs// bgyis pa'i dge bas chos don kun// rnam 'byed blo gros rgyas gyur cig /ces 'jam dpal ye shes bzang po'i bstod sgrub nyams su len tshul 'di ni/ o rgyan rab dga'i ngor sngon gyi yi ge rnying pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu sug bris bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab 'od brgya zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// phyogs bcu'i lus med thul gyi dbang po kun// bskyed pa'i yab gyur na yang bgrang ba'i gzhi// bcu drug lang tsho'i 'jo sgeg mthong na dga'// bla ma 'jam dpal gzhon nu snying gar rol// khyod kyi sgrub thabs grangs med skye ba'i phreng*// rjes bzung shes bya kun mkhyen sa skya pa'i// zhal lung byin rlabs ma nyams nyi ma'i drod// brgya phrag 'bar ba 'dir spel gnang ba stsol// de'ang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed pa'i lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs la brgyud pa'i lugs srol du ma mchis pa las/

'dir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dze tā re nas/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba/ des rje sa skya pa chen po la stsal te bsgrubs pas 'jam dpal gyis zhal dngos su bstan/ zhen pa bzhi bral zhes pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam srol yongs su rdzogs par ston par stsal/ de nas bzung ste phyi dang nang gi shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i mkhyen rab rgyas shing*/ chos kyi dka' gnas the tshom thams cad nyin mtshan kun du 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dral bar mdzad/ brgyud pa'i rim pa phal che ba'ang 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs pa sha stag tu byung ba de las brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pas/ 'di'i rjes gnang thob cing sha chang sgog btsong rdzun dang 'khrig pa rnams spangs pas/ gnas yid du 'ong bar bde ba'i stan la 'khod de/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥdamar ser gur gum gyi mdog 'dra ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/

lus thams cad la khyab pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bcom/ dri ma med pa'i 'od ltar gyur pa las/ skad cig gis rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od gsal ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas mi shes rmongs pa gcod pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i na tshod can/ ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i lhag ma zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan zhing 'od zer mu med par 'phro ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la yun ring du bsgom/ bsgoms pas skyo na sngags bzla ba ni/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dhīḥyig gi mthar oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes pas bskor ba dang*/ lce'i rtsa bar dhīḥdamar ser mgo bo gre phugs su bstan nas nyal thabs su gnas pa gsal bar dmigs nas bzlas pa bya/ skabs 'gar snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas 'jam dpal gyi skur gyur/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par bsdus nas/ thugs kar thim pas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros phun sum tshogs par rgyas par byin gyis brlabs par mos la sngags bzla/

thun mjug tu lce'i rtsa ba'i dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs par mos la/ dbugs thogs gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ rdzogs pa dang mchil ma cung zad mid pas lus dhīḥyig tu gyur par bsam/ thun las langs pa na/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus dang*/ gang gi blo gros sogs kyis bstod/ rgyas par na mtshan yang dag par brjod pas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa mi shes pa'i rmongs pa thams cad bcom nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags pa 'jam dpal 'grub gyur nas zhes sogs kyis dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngos la/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// gtor ma 'bul na/ dkar gtor gtsang ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ gtor mgron rgyas par na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥdamar ser sogs nas zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ 'od zer mu med par 'phro ba snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ la sogs pas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/

ye shes sems dpa' dgug bstim dang*/ dbang bskur te spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i rgyas 'debs pa rnams spyi ltar bya/ bsdu na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang gsol gdab byas/ ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bshags nas rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gtor mgron rgyas pa ltar na dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod cing dge ba bsngo ba la sogs pa bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis zla ba drug gam 'bum phrag brgyad la sogs pa bsnyen pas/ nyams snang ngam rmi lam du ral gri dang ut+pa la bsrel ba dang me 'bar ba dang nyi zla shar ba sogs byung na 'grub par nye ba'i ltas su shes par bya zhing*/ byin rlabs ci tsam myur ba de tsam du bar chad kyi rtags kyang 'byung srid de/ sprin nag 'thibs pa dang*/ thog ser 'khrugs pa/ rlung nag 'tshubs pa/ mun khung du zhugs pa/ gcan gzan gyis zos pa la sogs pa byung na/ de sel bar byed pa ni/ rang skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba shin tu 'jigs pa'i skur bsgoms pa'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du/ hūm̐ gi mthar oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bskor ba las/ 'od zer sngon po tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros pas bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsregs par bsams la sngags de nyid bzlas pas zhi bar 'gyur ro// 'di'i rjes su gnang ba ni rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen pa dang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig cha gang rung ltar bya'o// chos kun rgyal ba dngos dang mkhyen gcig tu// legs par 'doms pa'i rgyal po sa skya pa'i// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i skye bar rim brgyud pa'i// 'jam dpal sgrub thabs shes rab 'od brgya pa// rdo rje'i tshig gi gling gzhan mkhar rgyu ba// kho bo'i rnam par dpyod pa'i shing rtar brten// rgyal bstan kun gsal yangs pa 'dir drangs la// kun dga'i 'dab brgya mi 'dzums ga la srid// dge des sems can kun gyi gti mug shing*// gcod byed gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mtshon// rnon po 'dzin pa'i mchog de mngon gyur nas// rnam 'dren bstan la phan pa'i las byed shog

/ces 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab 'od brgya zhes bya ba 'di ni don gnyer gyi ngor/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad can dang*/ de'i gsal byed chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa nyid gzhir bzung der bsdus shing tshig sdud mang ba sogs kyis kha 'gengs 'os pa cung zad dang bcas te nyams su blang bde bar/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas rab byung 'dod pa'i me byi lo'i khrums zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum par bris pa sarba maṅga la bha wa tu// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes gcig gyur pa// mi shes mun pa sel mdzad lhag pa'i lha// 'jam pa'i dbyangs khyod snying gi pad+ma'i dbus// byang chub bar gyi dge ba'i bshes su bzhugs// srid pa kun du rab byung khrims gtsang ldan// bcu phrag rig pa'i gtsug lag kun gyi gzhung*// legs par rtogs nas sems can khams rnams su// 'chad rtsod brtsam pa'i snang chen 'gyed par mdzod// legs pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen rnams// nyi 'od dang phrad mun pa ltar zhi nas// thub mchog gsung gis rab bsngags mthun pa'i rkyen// sprin sngon dus kyi mtsho ltar 'phel bar shog /ces 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa nyung ngu 'di'ang dge tshul shākya chos 'phel gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi spyod pa rjes su sgrub pa'i smon lam 'jam dpal dgyes par bskyed pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog gsum// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// 'gro la phan pa bsgrub pa'i phyir// smon lam pha rol phyin pa bsgrub// bdag cag mos pa'i khang pa ru// rtse gcig sems kyis legs bris pa'i// smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang po mchog

/gang dag bzhugs pa 'di lta ste// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs kyi// mkhyen dang brtse ba nus pa'i gter// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs// rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur kyang*// lo grangs bcu drug lon 'dra'i sku// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i 'od// nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od la 'gran// ma rig gcod la rno ba'i mtshon// mkha' ltar sngo ba'i ral gri dang*// rgyal ba'i yum gyur shes rab kyi// pha rol phyin pa'i glegs bam dag /rin chen gdub kor mdzes pa'i phyag /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i ut+pa la// 'dab ma rgyas pa'i ge sar rtser// 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bsnams pa po// sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' yis// 'ja' tshon gsar pa'i dpal la sdang*// rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa las// gdub sil snyan pa'i sgra snyan 'khrol// srid pa gsum gyi mdzes pa'i dpal// gcig tu spungs lta'i bzhin ras la// dkar nag rnam par 'byes pa'i spyan// zim bur lta ba dkyus su ring*// srab cing mnyen pa'i ljags yangs dang*// dkar zhing 'dzum pa bzhi bcu'i tshems// 'gebs par byed pa'i mchu yi sgros// ban+du dzī ba ka ltar dmar// gang las 'ongs pa'i gsung gi dpal// yan lag drug cu rdzogs pa las// gtsug lag bye ba grangs med ni// sems can kun gyi bsam par 'jo// khyod thugs ye shes me long du// yongs su chud par ma byas pa'i// ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas// 'ga' yang med pa'i ngo mtshar rmad// de lta'i mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// kun nas lhun chags yangs pa'i khri// pad+ma zla bas brgyan pa la// dgyes pa'i nyams kyis brtan par bzhugs// de yi steng phyogs yangs pa dang*// mtha' skor kun gyi nam mkha'i khams// til gyi gang bu til gyi 'brus// yongs su khengs ltar bzhugs pa ni// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sdom pa'i rgyun bzung nas// skal ba ji bzhin 'doms mdzad pa'i// bla ma mkhan por gyur pa dang*// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde bzhis// bstan bya mchog dang thun mong gi

/dngos grub 'dren pa'i shing rta che// yi dam lha tshogs thams cad dang*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// dus gsum gshegs dang bzhugs pa yi// chos kyi sgron ma bla na med// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang*// 'gro ba sgrol ba'i thugs bskyed dang*// spyod pa rmad byung rgyal ba'i sras// phyir 'ong mi 'ong rgyun du zhugs// dgra bcom nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// chos dang chos mdzad bu bzhin du// skyong ba dam tshig rdo rje yi// ri mo snying gar gsal ba'i lha// srung ma rgya mtsho thams cad dang*// chos bzhin byed pa'i gang zag la// longs spyod mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// yangs par phye ba'i dngos grub gter// gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas// gzhan yang smon lam btab tsam gyis// phan 'dogs nus pa'i lha dang klu// drang srong bden tshig grub par bcas// smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang du bzhugs// phyag bgyir 'os pa thams cad la// bdag lus zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul// phra ba snyed du sprul pa'i lus// thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo// grangs med skye ba'i phreng ba ru// rang bzhin kha na ma tho'i sdig /bgyis dang bgyid du stsal ba rnams// stobs bzhi tshang ba'i cho gas bshags// phyogs dang phyogs bral 'jig rten na// gang dag bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa dang*// so so skye bos 'dus byas pa'i// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub mngon mdzad kyang*// chos kyi bdud rtsi mi spro ba// de dag spyan sngar mchis nas ni// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i snang ngo ru// rnam par bskal la mngon phyogs pa// de la mya ngan mi 'da' ba'i// gsol 'debs snyan pa'i glu ru len// stong gsum kun du mchod yon dang*// me tog spos dang mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo'i sgra dbyangs ni// ji snyed blo yis blangs nas 'bul// tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar// dus gsum kun du sgo gsum dang*// rjes su 'brel ba dge ba'i las// mngon par 'du bgyis thams cad dang*// dus 'dir rgyal dang rgyal sras kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rten bskrun dang*// phyag 'tshal mchod dang bskor ba byas// gsung rab 'dri klog 'dzin pa dang*// thos dang bsam dang rtse gcig bsgom// mdo dang sngags kyi bzlas brjod dang*// sems can phan par 'dod pa'i sems// skad cig skyes pa'i dge bar bcas// ma lus blo yis blangs nas ni// bla ma 'jam dbyangs 'khor dang bcas// dgyes par bskyed pa'i mchod sprin du// mngon par sprul te dbul bar bgyi// gces par bzung ba'i lus 'di yang*// mgon la 'bul gyi deng nas brtsams// bya ba gang dang gang byed pa// khyed kyi bran du mchi bar bgyi// gzhan sems mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug la// bdag gis gsol ba mi 'tshal yang*// bus pha yus pa'i ngud mo la// ma ni rjes su brtse ltar dgongs// bdag ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sngon// las 'brel yod pa zhig min na// khyed la mos gus gdung ba tsam// gzhan la mi che 'di ci ga

/de slad deng nas byang chub bar// 'jam pa'i dbyangs khyod bdag cag gi /dge ba'i shes su mi 'bral ba'i// smon lam 'bras su smin par shog /bdag gi pha ma gnyen bshes dang*// 'khor g.yog dud 'gro'i sems can bar// phan gnod 'brel pa gang yod kyang*// khyed kyi spyan sngar chud par shog /srid pa'i rgya mtshor byings gyur pa'i// 'gro ba gdon pa'i byang chub thugs// khyod kyis ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin// bdag kyang de ltar spobs par shog /dran pa nyer gzhag yang dag spong*// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa stobs la sogs// byang chub phyogs ni rdzogs byas pa// de bzhin bdag gis bgyid par shog /khyod kyi rtun pa rmad byung gis// spyod pa pha rol phyin bcu yi// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod pa ltar// bdag gi tshogs gnyis mthar phyin shog /de bzhin bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis// 'gro ba rgya mtsho byang chub tu// khyod kyis ji ltar smin byas pa// de dang de la bdag slob shog /mi dge'i grogs kyis bsgyur ba'i blo// mi dge'i lam du rgyug pa rnams// mi dge bzlog la khyod sgrin ltar// mi dge spong ba'i lam ston shog /sems can ma rig ldong ba rnams// blo ldan smra ba'i dbang phyug gi /go 'phang sbyin pa khyod kyi las// gang yin de la bdag slob shog /bdag tu lta ba gcod pa'i mtshon// bdag med shes rab ral gri khyod// bdag gi snying la zhugs 'dra yi// bdag med smra ba'i nyi mar shog /mngon par 'dod pa'i bcud kyi phul// rgyan mchog brgya dang bcu gnyis kyis// brgyan pa khyod kyi sku thob nas// 'khor ba srid du don byed shog /bsod nams dpag tu med pa'i 'bras// gsung dbyangs yan lag rdzogs pa de// bdag gis grub nas 'jig rten khams// chos kyi snang bas 'gengs par shog /ring nas sbyangs pa khyod kyi thugs// bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes gter// bdag la skyes nas chos kun gyi// khyab bdag chen po bdag gyur cig

/'jam pa'i dbyangs khyod bla med gnas// 'tshang rgya bgyid pa'i tshul bstan tshe// 'khor gyi gtso bo bdag gyur nas// byang chub lung bstan thob par shog /de skad ji ltar smon pa'i lam// de ltar 'grub pa'i bden dpang du// gang dag bzhugs pa khyed cag rnams// mthun 'gyur dbyangs su long shig kye// bdud las rgyal ba rdzogs sangs rgyas// chos min las rgyal dam pa'i chos// mu stegs las rgyal dge 'dun te// rnam rgyal gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ces 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi spyod pa rjes su bsgrub pa'i smon lam 'jam dpal dgyes par skyed pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni zhe'u mdo'i bla brang gi bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin dang dpal ldan phrin las gsum gyis bskul ba'i ngor rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tha snyad du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can dgyes pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas/ bod chen ljongs kyi sa'i thig le sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa phyogs thams cad du dge legs rnam par 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
